message.content: This editorial illustration for Tempo magazine, dated "18-24 MEI 2015," depicts a high-angle perspective of several office desks and chairs arranged on a textured orange-red surface. The desks are brown, rectangular, and made of a wood-like material, each paired with a blue, tufted, high-back office chair. White dashed lines, accompanied by white scissor icons, are drawn around some of these furniture sets. One set of lines forms a large, stylized bull-head shape around a desk in the lower-center foreground. Another dashed line encircles a desk in the upper-left, while a third line creates a radiating pattern from a desk on the right edge. Large white capital letters in the center read "RESHUFFLE UNTUK SIAPA." Above this, the word "TEMPO" is written in large, white, serif font. Additional text at the top includes "PANGGUNG BROADWAY MAMPIR KE JAKARTA" and "JUAL-BELI KONSESI JALAN TOL." A barcode and the price "RP 39.500" are located in the bottom-right corner. All chairs are empty, and the space appears sterile.
